title: Jade Cargill’s streak & Statlander’s return
summary: Jade’s undefeated run establishes the TBS title until a returning Kris Statlander accepts an immediate challenge.

chapters.title: The first TBS Champion
chapters.result: Cargill defeats Ruby Soho in the tournament final.
chapters.context: The new championship becomes central to Jade’s undefeated run.

chapters.title: Statlander ends the streak
chapters.result: After Jade beats Taya Valkyrie, Statlander returns and wins the TBS title.
chapters.context: The surprise second match ends Jade’s 60-win unbeaten streak.
